pr.title: Refactor expiration comparison
pr.body: is_expired(now, expires_at): timestamps use the same unit; validity ends exactly at expires_at.

base_files.module.py:
def is_expired(now, expires_at):
    return now >= expires_at

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def is_expired(now, expires_at):
-    return now >= expires_at
+    remaining = expires_at - now
+    return remaining < 0

gold_issues.description: The strict comparison treats a credential as valid at its exact expiration timestamp.

findings.description: The logic for determining expiration has changed from a direct comparison to a calculation of remaining time, which may introduce errors if the timestamps are not in the same unit. The original implementation was clearer and directly compared the two timestamps.

decisions.rationale: Timestamp-unit/style warning misses the changed equality behavior; the contract already requires common units.

normalization_notes: Reviewed final JSON, submitted body and inline comments together. Merged the same allegation across channels; retained all distinct defect allegations.
